856-5776-8249-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

176-4875-8250.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax.
Repeat.

654-5531-5694-6927-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-5531-5694-6927-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-5531-5694-6927-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Damage Control Crew and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-6112--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

586-1796-4247-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4247-6730-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 4.
Repeat.

4681-4730-6542-8095.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4640-5686-7082--201.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7829-7832.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7829-7832.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

2741-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2741-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1203-1330.easyPrerequisites: You have more life than an opponent.
1203-1330.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by {1}{B}{R} and paying an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total, dealing that much damage to Truefire Captain.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.

3966-7286.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3966-7286.description:
Gain life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2292-3558-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2511-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-4365-4660-5676.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Bloodshot Cyclops.
2178-4365-4660-5676.notablePrerequisites: Bloodshot Cyclops does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4365-4660-5676.description:
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing Reef Worm.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating two 3/3 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Fish.
When the Fish dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Fish trigger, creating two 6/6 Whale creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 6, dealing damage equal to the FIsh's power to any target.
Repeat from step 6 using the other Fish token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Whale.
When the Whale dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Whale trigger, creating two 9/9 Kraken creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 12, dealing damage equal to the Whale's power to any target.
Repeat from step 12 for each other Whale token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Kraken.
When the Kraken dies, Bloodshot Cyclops triggers, untapping Bloodshot Cyclops.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 18, dealing damage equal to the Kraken's power to any target.
Repeat from step 18 for each other Kraken token.

488-1492-4708-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Dark Sphere or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1492-4708-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

38-2316-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
38-2316-2440.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblins enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times, adding {C}{C}{C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat.

851-2557-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

2232-2837-3558-5270.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Samwise Gamgee's first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-3842-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one permanent card in your graveyard.
141-3842-4050.description:
Cast Planewide Celebration by paying {5}{G}{G}, choosing the first mode three times and the third mode once.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {1}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Planewide Celebration.
Resolve the Planewide Celebration copy, creating three 2/2 Citizen creature tokens and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Citizens, adding {1}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

277-584-1737-2092-2544.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
277-584-1737-2092-2544.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Silverbluff Bridge.
When Silverbluff Bridge enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Silverbluff Bridge token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

523-2136-4840.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
523-2136-4840.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Myr Battlesphere with haste.
When the Myr Battlesphere tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating twenty 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, Orthion triggers, causing you to sacrfiice the Myr Battlesphere tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Hellkite Tyrant's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

2300-4871.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control can die.
2300-4871.description:
Have a creature you control die.
Pitiless Plunderer makes a treasure token.
The token enters and dies as a 0/0.
Pitiless Plunderer makes a treasure token.
Repeat

2187-2665-3617.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Possessed Skaab.
2187-2665-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the token Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
